_comment: Curated MCP server catalog for the in-app 'Browse catalog' picker. Intentionally empty for now. To add an entry, append an object to `servers`. stdio (local) example: { "id": "filesystem", "name": "Filesystem", "description": "Read/write files in a directory", "category": "Files", "homepage": "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers", "transport": "stdio", "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"], "required_env": [] }. http (remote) example: { "id": "example", "name": "Example", "description": "...", "transport": "http", "url": "https://mcp.example.com", "required_env": [{ "key": "API_KEY", "label": "API key", "secret": true, "help_url": "https://example.com/keys" }] }. See docs/prds/2026-06-03-mcp-registration-ux.md.
